Frames13-16 return to exactly the initial ready pose. Clearly show an actual sliding pump with the same fixed-length barrel. Never open the receiver like a double-barrel. Preserve exact identity, original armor color palette, planted boots, body height and head size, weapon model and rigid mechanical shapes, same fixed light. Keep the character's existing direction and point the gun that way: north up away from viewer, south down, east right, west left. Do not turn toward the viewer or use front pseudo3D view. Full body and weapon always visible with transparent margins.)

Frames7-9 break open the shotgun at its real hinge, tilt the TWO rigid barrels down together, eject exactly two spent shells. Frames10-13 insert exactly two fresh shells into the open breeches with the free hand. Frames14-16 swing the barrels back closed and settle into initial ready posture. No pump slide, no third barrel, no stretching barrel lengths. Preserve exact identity, original armor color palette, planted boots, body height and head size, weapon model and rigid mechanical shapes, same fixed light.
